capabilities: Plan tasks on a time-slotted plan track
Record actual times by dragging todos onto the actual track
Carry unfinished todos to another date or to today
Write each day's plan as an ordinary Markdown file in a configurable folder
Rename and reschedule todos with all three views staying in sync
disambiguation: Not a finance ledger; the name refers to a daily planning ledger built on the T-grid note method from the book Cognitive Awakening.
extras: Manual install only until community directory approval; desktop-only (isDesktopOnly: true), readable on mobile via the rendered Markdown table; no network requests or telemetry; release runbook and contributor docs are in Chinese.
problem: Obsidian daily notes are freeform text, with no structured view for planning a day's tasks against time slots and recording what actually happened.
summary: Daily planner that stores each day as a Markdown T-grid file with a linked todo list, plan track, and actual time track.
